name: yaoharee-lahtee-readout
description: Readout Universe — a Philosophy and Logic for Grounding Claims. Gives a small, machine-checkable tier vocabulary (Th_coqc, finite_diagnostic, Dr, Open, fit_calibrated, definition) so a claim's evidentiary support is stated honestly instead of rounded up to "proven," plus the readout-not-truth stance the tiers enforce. Developed by Yaoharee Lahtee.

plugins.name: readout-universe
plugins.description: Load before stating any claim's evidentiary status — a physics result, a software metric, a benchmark number, a philosophical argument, or your own prior output — as 'proven,' 'verified,' or 'true' without qualification. Carries the readout-not-truth stance and the tier vocabulary (Th_coqc / finite_diagnostic / Dr / Open / fit_calibrated / definition) for tagging exactly how well-supported a claim is, plus pointers into the full Readout Universe textbook and corpus (philosophy.md, logic.md, paradoxes.md) for depth.
